corroboration.output_side_finding: contamination-to-regression.json: v3 emits <|reserved_special_token_0|> on 2500/2500 cti-mcq and 1000/1000 cti-rcm, 0/500 cybermetric, 0/110 secqa; base and comparator 0 % everywhere.
corroboration.reading: If the token is present in the training targets, the output-side emission is learned behaviour, and the per-benchmark 100 %/0 % split tracks which training sources carry it.

reference_comparison.method: full-line SHA-256 per source; a row counts as identical when its full line hash appears in the reference corpus. Row counts are ROWS; the identical count is DISTINCT full-line hashes, so a source that contains duplicate lines shows fewer identical lines than rows.
